setup.step2Guide2: Enter exactly this address as the OAuth Redirect URL (no trailing slash):
setup.step2Guide4: Copy Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below.
setup.botLoginHint: Twitch username of the bot account (e.g. streambingo_bot), not your main account.
setup.step3Intro: Generate a token for the bot account on twitchtokengenerator.com.
setup.step3Guide1: Click the link below to open twitchtokengenerator.com
setup.step3Guide4: Log in with the bot account (not your main account!)
setup.step3Guide5: Copy Access Token and Refresh Token into the fields below.

setup.botRefreshTokenHint: Enables automatic token renewal. Without it, the token must be updated manually when it expires.

help.title: Help & Documentation
help.viewersItem1: Log in with your Twitch account.
help.viewersItem2: Redeem Channel Points (SELF) to receive a bingo card.
help.viewersItem3: Numbers are automatically marked on your card.
help.viewersItem4: Once a row, column, or diagonal is complete, click "Report BINGO".
help.moderatorsItem3: bingo – Confirm bingo in chat (as viewer)
help.moderatorsItem4: Use the Moderator Dashboard for a full overview of all cards.
help.redeemsItem1: Create Channel Point Redeems in your Twitch Creator settings.
help.redeemsItem2: Enter the Redeem title in the Streamer management.
help.redeemsItem3: SELF-Redeem: Viewer receives their own card.
help.redeemsItem4: GIFT-Redeem: Viewer enters a username; that person receives a card.

home.subtitle: Play Bingo live with your Twitch community – real-time, on any device.
home.roleStreamerDesc: Create bingos, configure redeems, manage your game.
home.roleViewerDesc: Get your personal 5×5 bingo card and mark numbers live.
home.roleModeratorDesc: Monitor all cards and manage drawn numbers via chat command.
